canonical_title: Foxconn confirms talks on expanded AI infrastructure collaboration with OpenAI
aliases: Foxconn Sam Altman AI server partnership
treatment: Report chairman's confirmation of discussions once, clearly mark unsigned/undetailed status. Reinclude only for official signed deal, contract terms, capacity, pricing, investment or new supply-chain impact.
known_facts: At Foxconn's Oct 30 technology event, chairman Young Liu said he met OpenAI CEO Sam Altman earlier and that a new collaboration was being worked on; details and announcement are pending.
The prospective collaboration would build on a 2025 agreement covering design/engineering of AI data-center racks, components and other hardware; no new contract terms were announced.
Reuters reported Oct 30 at 08:38 UTC (=17:38 JST), after the midday window boundary.
Foxconn reported six AI-server factory buildings in Houston and suggested further expansion; this is company commentary, not a confirmed new OpenAI order.
reinclude_only_if: Foxconn or OpenAI publishes signed deal, technical scope, timeline or capital commitments.
New independently verified manufacturing or procurement effect emerges.
notes: NEW factual confirmation of negotiations; NOT a finalized new agreement. Avoid conflating the 2025 partnership with this discussion.
